Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 3.3, 6.2, 11.2; courts C/J/K. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M16KDH0TM7DF2BC0K08TH0TT; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7BD356ZAYJ5JQ1G7TTTT.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own integrated keyboard/focus/table behavior and browser courts, reusing shared actions. One active row/cell, ordinal first/last/jump, target reveal, accessible candidate actions and drawer return replace thousands of tab stops. Do not fork data or scientific handlers for the table.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Keyboard/table user completes ambiguity -> nonwinning evidence -> return with every unit/outcome reachable, preserving canonical text selection.
2. Focus is qualified by identity across updates, resize and 200% zoom; visible focus, non-color semantics, contrast and reading order are inspected at DPR1 and DPR2.
3. No hover-only facts, focus trap or stale denied accessible text; browser ownership audit and cleanup are recorded.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Retain exact accessible list/table and current standalone keyboard paths; do not certify an inaccessible projection.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Complete keyboard and accessible-table inspection parity
